cards.verse_text: Five days later the high priest Ananias came down with some elders and a lawyer named Tertullus, who presented to the governor their case against Paul.

cards.card_text: He also has a favor to ask about two men, Zenas the lawyer and Apollos.
cards.verse_text: Do your best to equip Zenas the lawyer and Apollos, so that they will have everything they need.
